items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty signals negative open; Asia markets mixed; Brent crude near $87
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: The GIFT Nifty indicated that the Nifty50 may extend losses. Asian markets were trading on a mixed note

items.title: LEAP India shares list at 4% premium over IPO price, miss expectations
items.description: LEAP India share price opened at ₹166 on the BSE, up 4.40 per cent over the issue price. Meanwhile, on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), it listed at a 4.34 per cent gain at ₹165.90.

items.title: Svatantra Microfin files papers with Sebi for ₹3,000 crore public offer
items.description: The proposed IPO comprises a fresh issue and an offer for sale of Rs 1,500 crore each; fresh proceeds will be used to augment the microfinance lender's Tier-I capital
